title.en: Vertical rail in a scroll panel
title.zh: 滚动面板中的纵向导航

description.en: A left rail follows the report section nearest the top of a scoped scroll container.
description.zh: 左侧导航跟踪滚动容器中距离顶部最近的分区。

description.en: orientation="horizontal" turns the rail into a sticky tab strip above settings sections.
description.zh: orientation="horizontal" 把导航变成设置分区上方的吸顶标签栏。
